question: Which among the following data was used to compute the estimates in the national Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) Baseline Report?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Family Health Survey (NFHS-4)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)** is used to measure multidimensional poverty across various parameters such as education, health, and standard of living.
 
• The **National Family Health Survey (NFHS-4)**, conducted in **2015-16**, served as the primary data source for computing the baseline estimates for the MPI.
